info.name: Booking.com Car Rentals Accommodations OTA Availability API

items.docs: Updates availability and restrictions using the OTA OTA_HotelAvailNotif specification. An alternative to the B.XML availability endpoint that follows the OpenTravel Alliance format.
Updates rate amounts and pricing using the OTA OTA_HotelRateAmountNotif specification. An alternative to the B.XML availability endpoint for rate-only updates.
